channel.title: GitHub Swift Languages Daily Trending
channel.description: Daily Trending of Swift Languages in GitHub

item.title: xtool-org / xtool
item.description: Cross-platform Xcode replacement. Build and deploy iOS apps with SwiftPM on Linux, Windows, macOS.

item.title: hugeBlack / GetMoreRam
item.description: A simple AltSign wrapper app that allows you to enable "Increased Memory Limit" to your sideloaded apps without using Xcode

item.title: LiveContainer / LiveContainer
item.description: Run iOS apps without actually installing them!

item.title: lingyired / status-trio
item.description: Status Trio — a native macOS app that combines Wi-Fi, battery, and volume into one compact, configurable status icon for the menu bar, the Dock, or both, inspired by the iPhone Duo combined status bar.

item.title: manaflow-ai / cmux
item.description: Open source Ghostty-based macOS terminal with vertical tabs and notifications for AI coding agents. Built for multitasking, organization, and programmability.

item.title: claration / feather
item.description: Free on-device iOS/iPadOS application manager/installer, using certificates part of the Apple Developer Program.

item.title: FrizzleM / SideInstaller
item.description: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device

item.title: groue / GRDB.swift
item.description: A toolkit for SQLite databases, with a focus on application development

item.title: jithin-sabu / purge-app
item.description: Free up your Mac. Safely. A free, open-source native Mac app that clears the cache and junk your Mac piles up on its own. Files go to the Trash by default, so you can put them back.

item.title: iliyami / MacSai
item.description: Mac Sai: the open-source Mac cleaner, optimizer, and malware scanner. A free, Apple-notarized alternative to CleanMyMac, built with Swift 6 and SwiftUI.

item.title: altstoreio / AltStore
item.description: AltStore is an alternative app store for non-jailbroken iOS devices.

item.title: ob-f / OpenBot
item.description: OpenBot leverages smartphones as brains for low-cost robots. We have designed a small electric vehicle that costs about $50 and serves as a robot body. Our software stack for Android smartphones supports advanced robotics workloads such as person following and real-time autonomous navigation.
